children: reported a 10% rise in first-half underlying net profit on Friday, helped by strong performance from its Australian unit Optus and regional associates including India's Bharti Airtel
Southeast Asia's largest telecom operator said underlying net profit for the six months ended September 30 was S$1.49 billion ($1.16 billion), higher than S$1.35 billion a year ago.
